column3: what a person found when reading (BM16, 2026-11-08). Edit here, then re-run node scripts/requirements-register.mjs
(BM18 closed) Clocks are shown and tested, but nothing detects that the phone's or the ship's zone changed and tells the guest. No such wording anywhere in src or the strings file.
(BM18 closed) No statement that crew instructions and announcements override app content, on the muster card or anywhere else.

(BM45) Boarded comes from the server (EmbarkView.boarded, with a manifest or scan source; BoardedSource in src/domain/embark.ts). The manifest is simulated and nothing yet writes a scan; the guest's typed time is only a planning estimate.
(BM18 closed) No wording or state separating the guest's departure preference from the assignment made by operations.
Refund timing is now worded as an estimate until the card company confirms it (BM42, hub.portSkipped.comp.arrives). Still open: no payment-provider confirmed state, other refund lines not read.

(BM44) Folio lines carry a state (posted, pending, disputed, refunded, adjusted; FolioStates, dbo.FolioLines.State); the final bill lists refunded and adjusted lines apart and marks queried charges. Still open: nothing yet sets pending, and no official receipt export was read.

(Reconciled) Sign out everywhere built in BM35 (POST /auth/logout-all). Device list built in BM46 (POST /auth/sessions/list, DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}, from refresh-token families). BM54 added a new-device notice on the device list. Still no step-up check.
(BM41) Documents are access-scoped on the server; push previews for payment, travel and schedule-change alerts are redacted by PushRules.Redact. Encryption at rest and export/delete not read.
(BM45) Aboard requests show a team, stage, ETA, the reason when there is no ETA, and an escalate action. The owner is a team, not a named person; escalation records a request only, nobody is paged.
(BM45) Aboard requests can be escalated, confirmed fixed or reopened, with the history kept (dbo.ServiceRequestEvents). No crew workflow writes the stage; it still follows the clock.
(BM18 closed) HistoryScreen has no search or filter; trips are listed, receipts shown.
(BM18 closed) No Princess-operated versus independent label found in PortCard or excursions.ts.
(Reconciled) ChatService applies ServiceRules.ChildSafeProblem by age on the server (no phone numbers or links, no photos for under-18s); ChatSafe gates photos by PHOTO_MIN_AGE.
(Reconciled) Sign out everywhere built in BM35; device list (BM46) and new-device notice (BM54) built; no step-up check. See IDN-01.
